blurb: Balu Yoga offers a variety of yoga classes for all levels, private classes for small groups, and outdoor classes by the Columbia River when weather permits. They provide memberships, drop-in classes, and sliding scale pricing to support community access. Additional wellness services include trauma-sensitive yoga and somatic therapy sessions.
